title: Chain of Responsibility Pattern — Runnable Implementations
title_es: Patrón Chain of Responsibility — Implementaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable Chain of Responsibility handler chain in Python, JavaScript and Java: auth, rate-limit and data handlers with fluent setNext wiring, short-circuit rejections (401/429) and a default fall-through case.
description_es: Cadena de handlers Chain of Responsibility ejecutable en Python, JavaScript y Java: handlers de auth, rate limit y datos con encadenamiento fluido setNext, rechazos por cortocircuito (401/429) y caso final por defecto.
